RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot be reliably quantified from these facts

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex bias. Neither does a woman’s appointment rule bias out. You and the successful candidate are both women, and nothing you’ve described specifically connects sex to the decision.

Your qualifications justify seeking an explanation, but publication counts and PhD status may not determine the outcome; industry experience, teaching performance and subject fit may matter.

Follow up in writing requesting the selection criteria, their weighting, feedback on your assessment and any available review procedure. Check whether a completed PhD was essential and whether appeal deadlines are running. Raise panel composition only if it breached an applicable rule or additional evidence suggests bias.
